quests.text: Leomon cannot leave the gym, and Kunemon keep wandering into Central Park. Thin them out.

offer.name: Leomon
lines: Hey there. The Kunemon have been wandering into Central Park again, and I cannot leave the gym to deal with them.
If you could thin out three of them, I would be grateful. I will make it worth your while.
Can you do that?
doneLines: Three less to worry about. Thank you.
Take this, you earned it.

quests.text: Couriers lose time to fights in the Wire Forest. Show a fight-free way through.

objectives.label: Cross the Wire Forest entrance from the north-west gate to the south gate without a fight

quests.title: Card ladder: first steps
quests.text: Prove yourself at the card table. Beat any three tamers.

quests.title: Card ladder: rising duelist
quests.text: Word is spreading. Beat six tamers in all.

quests.title: Double trouble in Central Park
quests.text: Two pests came out of the long grass at once. Face a Kunemon and a Tapirmon back to back, with no time to heal in between.

objectives.label: Beat a Kunemon and then a Tapirmon, back to back

offer.name: Leomon
lines: Something odd happened. Two pests came out of the long grass at the same time, a Kunemon and a Tapirmon.
Could you face them back to back? No time to heal in between. It is harder than it sounds.
Will you try?
doneLines: Both of them at once, and you are still standing. Impressive.
Here you go.
remindLines: Still after those two? A Kunemon, then a Tapirmon, back to back.
Do not stop to rest in between. Good luck.

objectives.name: Takato
lines: Guilmon? Is that you? I looked everywhere!

doneLines: I saw it in the way your partner stood. That is the Kunemon form.

remindLines: Still no Kunemon form? Keep fighting. Around level fourteen it should come to your partner.

quests.text: The Schoolgirl wants close-up notes on Tapirmon, and she wants you to learn the Tapirmon form to see what one feels like.

This is for the science. And for the notebook, which says thank you in its own way.
remindLines: Two Tapirmon, then the Tapirmon form. Does the nose twitch?

If you must send something, tell the Old Woman. She says saying a thing out loud does something. I have not checked.

It never arrives, of course. But a thing said to someone who listens is already half delivered.
Tell the boy he does not have to send it. He has to say it. I will remember every word, and so will you.

lines: Hey. Do you know what day it is? Me neither. I logged in for an hour and that was a long time ago.

doneLines: You are back. Be honest with me, I can take it. Is there a way?
remindLines: Any news? I keep watching the gate. Nothing goes through it, as far as I can tell.

quests.title: Dead Drop
quests.text: The Runner wants a message carried past three places before sundown, and wants nobody following you. Stand at each place, and deal with whoever follows.

objectives.label: Stand at all three places
Shake off the tail at Shell Beach

offer.name: Runner
lines: Do not look at me. Look at the trees. I am not here.
A message has to cross three places before sundown. I cannot carry it. Somebody is following me, and they are not very good at it.
Wire Forest gate. Shell Beach. Plug Cape. Stand at each long enough to look suspicious. Then come back and tell me nothing.
doneLines: You are back. And everyone who left behind you stayed behind you. Good.
The message was empty. I wanted to see who would follow the route. Nobody did, apart from one little pest. You dealt with it.
Here, take this. Lucky Mouse says thank you. He never says thank you. Do not tell him I told you.

It is for tomorrow. It is a secret. It is his day, the day he came online. I want to give him a surprise.
I do not know how to bake. Is there any sort of party food in this world? Thank you. Thank you twice.

Before I answer him, I need proof the cards are still worth it. Win two duels. If a stranger can do it, so can I.
